The EU supported the holding of elections, while the Americans and Israel opposed it. Internally, the public favored it, with 85 percent of Palestinians registered to vote. title: Israeli settlers injure Washington Post journalist in West Bank attack
description: Israeli settlers attacked a West Bank village, burning olive trees and injuring two people, including a journalist. The attack disrupted the village’s annual olive harvest.

title: Malnutrition stalks the most vulnerable in Afghanistan as aid cuts leave millions helpless
description: In Afghanistan, acute malnutrition levels have surged as food insecurity worsens, exacerbated by border closures and regional impacts. Aid cuts have severely limited assistance for those in need.

title: Romania resumes search for seven missing sailors from drone-hit ship
description: Romania has resumed efforts to find seven missing sailors from a chemical tanker hit by a drone near the Black Sea. This incident is part of a larger pattern of threats to shipping routes near NATO territories.

title: UN says Gaza malnutrition gains fragile as commercial supplies halt
description: The UN warns that Gaza’s progress against malnutrition is at risk due to halted commercial supplies following an Israeli decision amid a tax dispute.

title: Qatar PM reiterates support for Lebanese army
description: Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani reaffirmed his country's support for the Lebanese army during a meeting with President Joseph Aoun, emphasizing backing for Lebanon's efforts to regain control over its territory and address Israeli military presence. Aoun expressed gratitude for Qatar's ongoing assistance and highlighted the need for regional cooperation to restore stability and halt Israeli aggression.

title: France to witness a 'crossroads of anger' as mass protests expected on Saturday
description: PRESS REVIEW – Friday, October 16: French papers look ahead to Saturday's call for mass protests, which will bring together a number of social movements. Next, climate change has devastating consequences on communities in Afghanistan. Also, Libération publishes a special edition written in the style of Georges Perec. Finally, this year's animal of the year has been named.

title: No, this oil tanker didn’t carry Russian diesel to the United States
description: Following US President Donald Trump's October 9 announcement of an agreement signed with Russian President Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel into the United States, a number of pro-Russian social media accounts began claiming that a Russian oil tanker was already carrying thousands of barrels of diesel to the United States. The ship was actually carrying fertiliser.

title: EU and Canada seek closer ties: Will Canada become the EU's first associate member?
description: As the international context becomes more challenging for the European Union, the bloc is looking to boost its ties with like-minded allies. Canada is part of that architecture that the EU says it wants to build. The big news of EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's State of the Union speech in September was that Canada could become an associate member – an arrangement that does not exist for the EU's partners at the moment.
